title: Can Marathon Petroleum (MPC) Keep Rallying? Wells Fargo Says Yes
summary: Wells Fargo maintains an 'Overweight' rating on Marathon Petroleum (MPC) and raised its price target to $300, anticipating further rallies despite the stock's significant gains this year. This positive outlook is primarily driven by the EPA's larger-than-expected renewable fuel-credit exemptions for small refineries, which could lower costs and boost profitability for Marathon. However, the benefits might be temporary as the EPA considers reallocating obligations and the stock's valuation is already high due to extraordinary market conditions.

title: PG&E (PCG) and Edison (EIX) Sink After California Wildfire Liability Deal Falls Apart
summary: PG&E (PCG) and Edison (EIX) shares plunged after California lawmakers introduced a bill updating wildfire response that failed to shift liability away from publicly traded utilities, omitting Governor Gavin Newsom's proposal to prevent insurers from suing utilities. This omission led to analyst downgrades and PG&E announcing a strategic review and a $2 billion cut to its 2027 capital investment plan. While future legislative reforms could offer a rebound, unresolved wildfire liabilities are expected to remain a significant challenge for both companies.

title: Is Manulife Financial Corporation (TSX:MFC) The Name To Watch In Financial Stocks?
summary: Manulife Financial Corporation (TSX:MFC) is presented as a significant player in Canada's financial sector, noted for its diversified services including life insurance, health insurance, wealth management, and investment products. The company's stability is attributed to its varied revenue streams, prudent risk management, and international operations, particularly in high-growth Asian markets. The article highlights how Manulife's ability to navigate shifting interest rates and regulatory changes, coupled with its focus on cost management and capital allocation, positions it as a resilient financial stock to watch.

title: How Is Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) Navigating Market Changes?
summary: Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) is navigating market changes by leveraging its strong commercial and corporate banking operations. The bank benefits from commercial lending, which expands with business growth and rising interest rates, and its investment banking and capital markets services provide diverse revenue streams. BMO's diversified revenue and prudent risk management are key to its resilience in the evolving Canadian financial landscape.

title: KBR lands the front-end engineering job for a 250 MW Nebraska project designed to turn renewable hydrogen into e-methane
summary: KBR has been selected by the Live Oak consortium to provide front-end engineering design (FEED) services for a 250 MW Nebraska project. This project aims to produce e-methane from renewable hydrogen and biogenic carbon dioxide, marking a significant step in large-scale electric natural gas production in the U.S. The final investment decision is expected in 2027, with commercial operations projected to start by 2030, including plans for exporting e-NG to Japan.

title: Goldman Flags Risk of $120 Oil
summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. warns that oil prices could surge to $120 a barrel if Middle East shipping attacks escalate. The bank's co-head of global commodities research, Daan Struyven, highlights that increased geopolitical tensions, particularly surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, have already driven crude to its highest since July. Goldman recommends investors hedge risks by going long on natural gas and refined-oil products, as supply shocks are more significant in these markets.

title: Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW): Is the Next Move About Demand?
summary: With U.S. equity markets closed for Labor Day, attention for Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW) shifts to order activity, factory demand, automation, and infrastructure spending ahead of upcoming inflation data. title: McKesson Corp's negligence caused a data breach, a new class action lawsuit claims
summary: A new class action lawsuit has been filed against McKesson Corp., alleging that the company's negligence led to an August 2026 data breach compromising sensitive patient information, including Social Security numbers, diagnoses, and prescription records. The lawsuit claims McKesson failed to implement adequate security measures and notify affected individuals promptly. Plaintiff Michele Garand seeks damages and an injunction for stronger security protocols.

title: SLB Bets $4.1 Billion on the AI Data Center Boom
summary: SLB announced it will acquire Kelvion for $3.4 billion in cash and $0.7 billion in assumed debt to expand its data center business, focusing on thermal management for the AI boom. This acquisition aims to double SLB's revenue opportunity per gigawatt of delivered capacity and is expected to be accretive to earnings and free cash flow. While the deal diversifies SLB away from oilfield services, it carries risks related to potential overinvestment in AI data centers.

title: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO): Can Demand Outweigh Macro Risks?

title: Should Investors Buy KVUE as Margin Gains Offset Slow Sales Growth?
summary: Kenvue Inc. (KVUE) has shown improved earnings leverage due to strong margin gains, with adjusted operating margin rising 180 basis points and adjusted earnings increasing by 18.9% in the first half of 2026. While valuation is not demanding compared to peers, investors are advised to await stronger evidence of sustained volume growth and consistent margin expansion before considering it a clear buying opportunity, as reflected by its current Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).

summary: Apple is expected to unveil its first foldable iPhone, along with new iPhone 18 models and updates to home and wearable devices, this Wednesday. summary: Illumina, Inc. (ILMN) and Everpure, Inc. (P) are set to join the S&P 500 in September, replacing Builders FirstSource and The Trade Desk. This inclusion is expected to generate institutional buying from index-tracking funds, providing a technical boost and increased visibility for both companies. However, the long-term stock performance will depend on their underlying fundamentals, such as revenue growth and cash generation, after the initial rebalancing impact fades.

title: Outraged cruise passengers sound off about 'immense disappointment' after abrupt cancellation
summary: Royal Caribbean canceled an Alaska cruise aboard the Serenade of the Seas due to unspecified technical problems, leaving passengers frustrated after days of delays. The cruise line offered full refunds, future cruise credits, and reimbursement for flight changes to affected guests. Despite the "immense disappointment" expressed by many, the ship has a history of technical issues and was ready for its next scheduled sailing by September 6.

title: Card Factory plc (CARD) Executes Share Buybacks from 1 to 4 September 2026 via UBS AG London Branch
summary: Card Factory plc (CARD) has announced share buybacks conducted from September 1 to 4, 2026, through UBS AG London Branch. The company repurchased 294,376 shares on September 1, 279,390 on September 2, 359,404 on September 3, and 399,000 on September 4, all of which will be cancelled. The volume-weighted average prices for these buybacks ranged from 75.3848p to 73.7748p.

title: Springfield sues MGM Resorts as dispute over casino sale and host agreement escalates
summary: The city of Springfield has filed a lawsuit against MGM Resorts International, alleging the MGM Springfield casino has failed to meet commitments regarding gaming positions and employee numbers outlined in its host community agreement. This legal action escalates a two-year dispute that is further complicated by MGM's proposed sale of the casino's gaming operations, which requires city approval. MGM accuses Springfield officials of acting in bad faith to delay the sale rather than resolving the ongoing issues.

title: Lockheed Martin’s (LMT) Javelin JV Signs Co-Production MOU With Tata Advanced Systems
summary: Lockheed Martin's Javelin Joint Venture (JJV) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Tata Advanced Systems Limited for co-production of the Javelin All Up Round missile system in India. This partnership aims to establish a final assembly and integration facility in India and localize component manufacturing, broadening the Javelin's market reach and supporting faster deployment for India and regional allies. While offering strategic benefits by positioning production closer to a key buyer, the deal faces potential uncertainties related to India's defense procurement landscape, technology transfer challenges, and competitive pressures.

title: Citigroup (C) Moves Deeper Into China’s Capital Markets as Competition Intensifies
summary: Citigroup is expected to receive regulatory approval for its wholly-owned mainland brokerage business in China as early as September 2026, aiming to significantly expand its presence in the country's capital markets. This move will allow Citi to engage in A-share brokerage, underwriting, research, and principal trading, leveraging its existing client base. While offering substantial growth potential given the success of other Wall Street firms in China, the expansion faces intense competition from established players and domestic brokerages, along with geopolitical risks and the relatively small initial scale of Citi's operations.

title: REGN SHAREHOLDER ACTION REMINDER: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Regeneron (REGN) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on September 14, 2026
summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP has reminded Regeneron (NASDAQ: REGN) investors of the September 14, 2026 deadline to seek lead plaintiff status in a federal securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Regeneron made false or misleading statements regarding its Phase III Fianlimab-Libtayo Study, leading to significant stock price drops on April 29, 2026, and May 15, 2026, when issues with the study's statistical assumptions and primary endpoint failure were disclosed. Investors who purchased Regeneron securities between August 1, 2025, and May 15, 2026, are encouraged to contact the firm.

title: 3 Under-the-Radar Defense Stocks With Record Backlogs
summary: This article examines three under-the-radar defense stocks—ATI, Astronics, and Ducommun—that have reported record backlogs amid increased U.S. military spending. While backlogs indicate future business, the article cautions that they don't always guarantee immediate profits. It highlights ATI's strong pricing power and clean chart, Astronics' rapid growth balanced by high leverage, and Ducommun's record backlog offset by decelerating guidance, guiding investors to scrutinize beyond headline numbers.

summary: Diageo plc (DGE), a leading alcoholic beverages company, has received approval from the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) for its 2026 European debt issuance programme prospectus. This annual renewal outlines the issuance of debt instruments with Diageo plc as issuer and guarantor, alongside Diageo Finance plc and Diageo Capital B.V. as additional issuers. The program signifies Diageo's continued use of European capital markets for financing, a common practice for large multinational firms, though specific debt amounts were not disclosed.

title: ADP employment data and consumer credit among releases due Tuesday
summary: Tuesday, September 8, 2026, will be a pivotal day for financial markets with several key economic data releases scheduled. These include the ADP Employment Change Weekly report, providing insight into private sector job growth, and the Consumer Credit report, offering a perspective on household borrowing trends. Additionally, Treasury auctions will gauge investor demand for government debt, all of which are crucial for assessing the health of the U.S. economy and the trajectory of monetary policy.

title: Mate Security, Palo Alto Networks, and ServiceNow Join OpenAI’s First-Day Cyber Defense Signatories
summary: Mate Security, Palo Alto Networks, and ServiceNow have signed on as first-day signatories to OpenAI's "A Call to Action on Cyber Defense" initiative, which urges cybersecurity vendors, governments, and technology companies to coordinate on AI-powered defense. The initiative highlights the critical need to leverage AI to strengthen cyber defenses against increasingly sophisticated AI-enabled attacks. The participation of these three companies, each with distinct approaches to security, underscores the broad transition towards AI-powered defense as a strategic priority in the cybersecurity market.

title: CCOI INVESTOR ALERT: Bronstein, Gewirtz and Grossman, LLC Reminds Investors of Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. to Contact the Firm Today!
summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz and Grossman, LLC has issued an investor alert for Cogent Communications Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CCOI), announcing a class action lawsuit against the company and its officers. The lawsuit alleges that Cogent made materially false and misleading statements regarding its optical wavelength backlog, customer demand, financial capacity, and dividend policy. Investors who purchased CCOI securities between February 29, 2024, and May 1, 2026, are encouraged to contact the firm to learn more and potentially join the case by the September 21, 2026, lead plaintiff deadline.

title: [Press release] FDA approves Gilead’s Bixlenvo™, a new once-daily single tablet option for virologically suppressed adults with HIV, including those on complex regimens
summary: The FDA has approved Gilead Sciences' Bixlenvo™ (bictegravir 75 mg/lenacapavir 50 mg), a new once-daily single tablet regimen for virologically suppressed adults with HIV. This marks the first and only STR option for individuals on complex regimens who cannot use other available single tablet regimens. Bixlenvo combines bictegravir, an integrase strand transfer inhibitor, with lenacapavir, a first-in-class capsid inhibitor, and requires a two-day initiation dose with Sunlenca.

title: Drive-thru restaurant, Dollar General may be coming to London area
summary: A new Dollar General and a La Michoacana drive-thru restaurant are proposed for the rapidly growing London area, near Corpus Christi, Texas. Both properties require annexation into the city and rezoning from farm rural to permit construction. The City Council is expected to vote on these requests on September 8th.
